Results.ReviewText:
Yes, at first glance, the Weber Grills are expensive.  And worth the cost.  The cooking control and flame control is just superb.  It is a convection oven when the lid is closed so cooking is very quick.

Even more importance for me as the durability of the Weber Grill.  Yes, I have purchased much cheaper LPG grills and their life time was very short, most often just 3 to 4 years as replacement parts, even from "name" manufactures, are just not available.  Those friends and neighbors that have Weber Grills have their grills remained usable for more than a decade; and, when spare spare are needed, Weber has them and they are in stock.  So cost of ownership is a winner.

The grease and sauce drainage system is the best I have looked at.  Easy to inspect, keep clean and replace the trap.

Temperature control is simple -- just keep track of the temperature gauge.

I put mine together myself.   Very clear instructions that uses a picture only instruction book plus a video that can take you thru each step.  The instruction booklet was so detailed that it was all I needed.  Took me 3 hours and I worked alone [which is not the Weber suggestion].

I am a proud new owner and I expect to be a proud "experienced" owner a decade from now after enjoying many fire-cooked meals.
Results.Title: Get the best: cooking, endurance, cleanliness

Results.ReviewText:
I wanted a smaller gas grill to replace my previous grill which had been a workhorse. There are good features and features that aren't so good on this Weber. 

GOOD: I received it in good condition - no missing parts or shipping damage. It was easy for one person to assembly (some people might need a helper for a few minutes, but it really wasn't bad). The assembly directions were clear. It looks nice. So far after a few months of use, the burners ignite on the first or second push of the igniter button. It gets up to temperature very quickly.

NOT SO GOOD: There are hangers on the outside ends of the shelves for grill tools. As you can see from my pictures, you can't hang grill tools if you use the Weber grill cover designed to go with this grill. (The grill cover also doesn't hang low enough when bunched up to cover the bottom shelf, allowing rain to get into the inside - but that's a different review). Flare-ups have been fairly common. The warming rack is very narrow - I used to cook asparagus on my old grill's rack, but the spears fall off this one, or are knocked off when I close the lid. In general, I'm just having to get used to slightly different grilling techniques due to the smaller size and more direct heat than the old grill.

BAD: As many reviewers have mentioned, it is ergonomically very difficult to hang a full propane tank on the "fuel remaining" indicator. If you have any back or arm injuries, I seriously recommend you don't try. It's a great concept and seems to be pretty accurate. I will probably not hang completely full tanks on it anymore - I will wait until some of the gas is gone and the tank is lighter. And it will still be difficult.

UNKNOWN: I have not done a thorough cleaning yet so I'm not sure how easily it will clean up. I'm skeptical that the exterior "stainless" steel will look good for very long.
Results.Title: Decent grill with a few design shortcomings

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
